name: Create a cell group and retain approval state
description: A member creates a real cell group and sees its persisted pending status.
steps: Sign in
Open Cells
Create a group with a name and description
Refresh and reopen Cells
expected: The new group remains visible to its creator with pending approval status; no invented sample groups appear.

name: Edit group details and schedule a meeting
description: A group manager updates the group and schedules a future meeting.
steps: Open a group you manage
Edit its description and moderators
Schedule a future meeting
expected: The saved group details and meeting schedule are returned by the backend.

name: Record attendance and member development
description: A cell leader records attendance and creates member development and mentorship records.
steps: Open an approved group you manage
Record attendance for a meeting
Add a growth update for a member
Create a mentor and mentee pairing
expected: Each record is saved to the backend and appears in the group's reports.

name: Share group media and start a meeting
description: An authorized group member shares supported media and a leader starts a meeting.
steps: Open an approved cell
Upload an image or PDF
Start a meeting as leader or moderator
expected: Media is stored and recorded; meeting start is logged and push notifications are sent to the group's known members.

name: Invite a member and join a cell
description: A leader shares an expiring invite and a second signed-in account joins the approved cell.
steps: Sign in as the cell leader
Create and copy a member invitation
Open the invitation in a second account
Join the cell and open the member list
expected: The second account joins once, appears in the member directory, and the group activity records the membership.

name: Create a prayer room and share requests
description: Cell members create a prayer room, share a request and record that they prayed.
steps: Open an approved cell as a member
Create a prayer room
Share a prayer request
Mark that you prayed for the request
expected: The room and request persist, the prayer response is recorded once per member, and other members are notified.
